data.voice_note: Voces: Valentina (organizada) y Erik (como cebolla, con capas).
data.script: Valentina: Snow day! Everybody get dressed for the mountain. … Erik: I'm putting on two sweaters, one coat, one hat and two scarves. … Valentina: Two scarves? You look like a walking wardrobe! … Erik: Warm is warm! Where are my gloves? … Valentina: On the shelf, next to your yellow hat. … Erik: Ready! Wait… I can't put my arms down. … Valentina: Ha! Take off one sweater, engineer. … Erik: Better. Now: snowman time! Ours will be three metres tall!
